features: Auth: Consolidated to single auth system (SimpleAuth + SessionStore)
Auth: Real session token validation replacing accept-any-token bypass
Auth: Removed backdoor endpoints (/test-login, credential reset)
Auth: Fail-closed authentication middleware (deny on error)
Auth: Added auth to filesystem browse, settings, and image processing
Passwords: Upgraded from SHA-256 to bcrypt with lazy migration
Passwords: Minimum password length increased to 8 characters
Input: Safe tar extraction with path traversal prevention
Input: Upload filename sanitization against directory traversal
Input: SQL sort_by allowlists and LIKE wildcard escaping
Input: Mass assignment prevention via field allowlists
Network: SSRF protection blocking private/loopback IPs
Network: Redis authentication enabled with password
Network: Secure session cookies when behind HTTPS
Network: Restricted proxy trusted hosts from wildcard
Network: Replaced pickle cache serialization with JSON-only
Network: Sanitized error responses (no stack traces in API)
Network: Rate limiting and security validation middleware enabled
upgrade_notes: Existing SHA-256 passwords auto-migrate to bcrypt on next login
API error responses no longer expose internal details
